    for t_res, t_s in m.items():

            res = 0
            prob = 1.0
            for k in range(n):

                    res |= (t_res & no[k]) << (1 << k)
                else:
                    prob *= (1 - p[i][k])
            M[res] += t_s * prob
    m = M
